description: A young orphan enrolls at a remote boarding school where a shadowy presence lurks in the walls and the portraits refuse to keep secrets.
A desert farmhand joins an outlaw band to strike back at an empire of armored enforcers, guided by an old gunslinger with a mysterious past.
A penniless artist and a society girl fall in love aboard an opulent ocean liner, then must survive when the dead rise among the passengers.
A young lion prince is tried for a crime he did not commit while his scheming uncle seizes the pride, and only a shaman can prove the truth.
A queen's icy curse spreads from her fingertips, and her kingdom slowly freezes from within while a strange winter descends without end.
A billionaire's island theme park of resurrected predators descends into chaos when the power fails and the ancient beasts break loose.
A lone hacker in a rain-soaked city follows a stranger down a rabbit hole and discovers the world he knows is a beautiful lie.
A thief who steals secrets from dreams assembles a crew to pull the perfect job: planting an idea inside a rival's most guarded mind.
A camera crew documents the aging patriarch of a crime family as he passes his empire to the youngest son, who never wanted the crown.
A simple man with a pure heart drifts through cosmic history, from distant battlefields to the moonshot itself, touching every soul he meets.
A beloved old cowboy doll is replaced by a flashy space ranger, and the jealous rivals must team up to escape a toy-torturing neighbor.
An overprotective father rides the ocean current with a forgetful sidekick, crossing shark-filled territory to bring his son home.
A grumpy green recluse falls for a princess with a secret of her own, and both must learn that true love sees past the surface.
Earth's mightiest heroes must set aside their egos when a trickster god opens a portal above the city and an army pours through.
A beach town's golden summer turns bloody when a great white shark begins feeding on swimmers, and no one believes the local sheriff.
A lonely boy befriends a stranded alien, hides him from the authorities, and helps him build a device to call home.
A teenager is blasted back to the frontier days in a scientist's time machine and must ensure his own parents meet or he will never exist.
A farm girl is swept to a magical land where enchanted slippers grant her power over wicked rulers, and she assembles unlikely allies.
Two hitmen break into song between jobs, a boxer tap-dances his way out of a fix, and a glowing briefcase steals every scene.
A masked vigilante stalks the rain-slicked streets of a corrupt city while a grinning madman forces decent citizens to betray each other.
A farmer-turned-pilot rides a wormhole across the final frontier to find a new home for a dying Earth while time slips away from his daughter.
A boy who dreams of music is trapped in a house of the dead where every door opens onto memory, forgetting, and a family's buried secrets.
A headstrong young navigator and a boastful demigod bicker their way across an endless ocean to restore a stolen heart.
A boy accidentally left behind during the holidays turns his house into a fortress of booby traps to foil two bumbling would-be robbers.
A vacationing cop at a Christmas party discovers the festive gathering is a cover for a vault heist and takes on the crew alone.
A newcomer to high school takes the stand against the queen of the popular clique when a burned book of rumors lands everyone in the principal's court.
A poor boy's courtship of a rich girl survives letters, war, and class, even as the world outside crumbles into a plague of the walking dead.
A shy newcomer falls for a brooding clan of elegant blood drinkers while a rival predator hunts her through the rain-soaked woods.
A camera crew follows three friends as they retrace a lost night in a city of sin, hunting for the groom, a tiger, and their own memories.
A down-on-her-luck maid of honor duels a perfect rival for the spotlight during a wedding week of song, dance, and disastrous speeches.
Two geeky seniors embark on one epic quest for booze before graduation tears their friendship apart, with a clueless cop in hot pursuit.
A college wunderkind is deposed in a bitter courtroom war over the invention of a website that changed the world overnight.
A wronged general, stripped of rank and family, fights his way across a lawless empire to face the tyrant who destroyed his world.
On a conquered world, a chieftain's son rises to unite the scattered clans against an empire that rules the stars with an iron fist.
A relentless machine from the future hunts a waitress whose unborn son will doom its kind, and only one soldier stands between her and doom.
A Philadelphia club fighter gets one shot at the heavyweight title and trains to the beat of brass and strings, dancing up the museum steps.
A cynical nightclub owner in a foggy wartime port must choose between the love he lost and the cause that needs him most.
A headstrong belle schemes through war and ruin to win back the only man who ever refused her, learning too late what she truly wants.
A runaway embezzler checks into a lonely roadside motel where the boyish manager is devoted to a mother who never quite left.
A young trainee and a brilliant cannibal duet across a prison interview room while a killer who collects skins stalks the stage.
An insomniac office drone and a charismatic soap salesman bond over bruises and start an underground brawling circle that gets out of hand.
A banker wrongly convicted of murder spends decades fighting for justice from inside a brutal prison, where hope is the only contraband.
A death-row guard discovers his gentle giant of a prisoner carries a strange gift that brushes against the spirits of the dead.
A sullen girl's parents are cursed in a bathhouse of spirits, and she must take service there to earn their freedom before she is forgotten.
A country girl and a city boy wake up in each other's bodies, and their strange long-distance romance must survive time, distance, and disaster.
A struggling family schemes its way into a wealthy household, unaware that the basement hides a hunger that will spread through them all.
A young man's weekend at his girlfriend's family estate becomes a waking nightmare of hypnosis, swapped souls, and neighbors who smile too long.
A terrified family takes their farmhouse's unseen tormentor to court, where paranormal experts must present evidence the jury can believe.
In a town where children vanish, a band of misfits confronts a dancing clown that wears many faces and feasts on their deepest fears.
A failed performer spirals into madness after the city mocks him, igniting a clown-masked uprising that will burn the streets down.
A documentary follows a doll from a pink utopia as she ventures into the real world and discovers perfection was never the point.
A brilliant physicist who forged the ultimate weapon is called before a tribunal to answer for the legacy of the fire he unleashed.
A desert prince rides with the native tribes against the barons who strip his world of its precious spice, riding sandworms across the dunes.
A cocky starfighter pilot enters an elite academy among the stars, where rivalry, a crash, and a forbidden romance test his nerve.
A secret agent is framed for his team's deaths and must plan the perfect counter-heist while his own agency hunts him across the globe.
A whip-cracking archaeologist races rival grave robbers across the globe to recover a relic that raises the dead from their tombs.
A blacksmith and a rum-soaked rogue captain plan an audacious theft aboard a haunted ship whose crew owes its soul to the sea.
A clumsy noodle-loving bear is chosen as the valley's champion and must master the ancient art of believing before the enemy arrives.
A cranky widower ties his house to balloons and floats toward a lost paradise, with an overeager stowaway scout bickering at his side.
A trash-compacting robot tending a deserted Earth falls for a sleek probe and hitches a ride across the galaxy to save humanity.
A documentary crew sneaks into a famous Paris kitchen to uncover the rat hiding beneath the chef's hat, and the truth shocks the food world.
Two furry scream collectors discover that children's laughter powers the whole city, and the plant erupts into a joyous song.
Five tiny commanders pilot a young girl's mind-ship through the galaxies of her emotions after her family moves to a strange new world.
A jazz pianist dies on the brink of his big break and drifts through a foggy between-world, chasing the moment that got away.
In a family blessed with magical gifts, the one girl without power may be the only one who can save the house and the miracle itself.
A rookie bunny cop and a sly fox con artist dig through the underbelly of a city where predators are mysteriously going savage.
A supervillain plans the greatest heist in history while three orphan girls complicate every step and steal his heart instead.
Three loyal yellow servants wander the ages and the stars, searching for a master worthy of their boundless devotion.
A camera crew follows a desperate koala as he stages a talent competition to save his bankrupt theater, with the city's oddest hopefuls.
A sunshiny optimist and a grumpy survivalist bicker their way into danger to rescue their friends from creatures who eat happiness.
A newborn in a suit and tie masterminds a corporate heist with his reluctant older brother to stop a plot against all babies.
A polite young bear from the jungle arrives in a gray London household and melts the frosty hearts of a family one mishap at a time.
A reclusive confectioner lures children into his wonderland factory, where each tour stop ends with a guest mysteriously disappearing.
A poor boy's golden ticket opens a candy wonderland where every room erupts into song and each child learns a costly lesson.
A teenager volunteers for a televised death match staged by a corrupt regime, and her defiance sparks a rebellion in the districts.
In a city divided into five factions, a girl who fits none hides a rare power that could unite the city or destroy it.
Boys with erased memories wake in a walled glade with no escape while a strange virus rages beyond the shifting stone maze.
A shy literature student tumbles into a whirlwind affair with a wealthy young recluse who has very particular tastes in romance.
A New York professor flies to Singapore to meet her boyfriend's family and discovers they are among the wealthiest families on the continent.
A jazz purist and an aspiring star chase their dreams through a city of neon and broken promises, trading love for ambition along the way.
A young drummer's hunger for greatness becomes a waking nightmare as his teacher's methods turn monstrous and perfection demands blood.
A faded actor who once wore wings on screen stages a Broadway comeback while a voice in his head urges him to fly again.
A newspaper's small investigative team digs into a city-wide conspiracy that powerful institutions buried for decades, one source at a time.
A free musician is stolen and sold across a lawless frontier, enduring years of bondage before a stranger offers him a chance at freedom.
A fur trapper, left for dead in a frozen wilderness, crawls across the ice while the dead he buried rise behind him, driven by vengeance.
A lone drifter in a scorched wasteland commandeers a war rig and takes a stand against a tyrant's roaring motorcycle horde.
A retired gunman is drawn back for one last ride after outlaws take everything he loves, and he leaves a trail of blood across the underworld.
An undercover officer infiltrates a crew of street racers who double as master thieves, and family loyalty complicates every job.
A teenager's used car reveals itself as an armored robot from another world, and the war that destroyed its home follows it to Earth.
Pilots bond mind-to-mind with towering machines to defend the world against monsters rising from the deepest trenches of the ocean.
A titanic guardian rises from the sea when humanity faces a threat no weapon can stop, and a city's only hope is the monster itself.
A film crew captures a colossal ape from a lost island and parades him through a city, with catastrophic results caught on camera.
An astronaut crashes on a world where intelligent apes rule and humans are hunted for sport, and the truth is worse than the nightmare.
Children born with strange powers are put on trial for gifts they never chose, and a school for outcasts becomes the center of the case.
A bitten teenager prowls the city in a mask, hunting the criminals who took his uncle's life and learning that power demands sacrifice.
The heir to a hidden African kingdom inherits the power of a great cat spirit and must reclaim his throne from a cousin who would arm the world.
A warrior princess from a hidden world joins a war among the stars, believing love can stop the god of war himself.
A lighthouse boy learns he is the heir to an undersea empire and must claim its legendary trident to unite a divided realm.
A thief, an assassin, a raccoon, a tree, and a brute bicker their way across the cosmos to stop a mad zealot from destroying everything.
A wisecracking masked mercenary with a healing factor goes to murderously romantic lengths to win back the love of his life.
An aging gunslinger with metal claws escorts a strange child across a dying frontier, pursued by those who want to weaponize her.
A down-on-his-luck journalist and the wisecracking alien sharing his body bicker their way through the city's underworld.
Players sucked into a cursed board game are granted heroic avatars with wild abilities and must survive the jungle to finish the quest.
A pair of bickering siblings play a metal board game that flings their house across the cosmos, with each turn raising the stakes.
A night guard's first shift reveals that the exhibits in an old building come alive when the doors close, and history has a temper.
Twin sisters who never met become fast friends and conspirators, switching places to reunite the divorced parents they each miss.
A stressed mother and her teenage daughter wake up in each other's bodies the day before a wedding and learn to walk in each other's shoes.
A camera crew follows a wealthy high-school queen as she remakes a new student in her own image, with mixed and hilarious results.
A pink-loving sorority star follows her ex to law school and surprises everyone, including herself, by winning the biggest case of the term.
A young assistant's dream job becomes a waking nightmare ruled by a fashion tyrant who destroys assistants for breakfast.
A demanding editor blackmails her assistant into a sham marriage for a visa, then brings him home to meet a family that steals her heart.
A perennial bridesmaid's endless wedding season turns into a scramble when the undead crash every ceremony she has ever stood in.

original: How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days
description: A journalist's plan to scare off a suitor in ten days collides with an outbreak that turns the whole city into the undead.
A humble bookshop owner falls for the most famous actress in the world when she wanders into his shop, and somehow she stays.
Nine intertwined stories of the heart unfold across London while the dead rise, and love endures through every gesture and sacrifice.
A bumbling romantic keeps meeting the woman of his dreams at ceremonies, but every event is overrun by the undead and he still cannot confess.
A chaotic singleton's diary of diets, disasters, and bad decisions continues uninterrupted even as the city around her falls to the dead.
A bride-to-be on a sunlit Greek island invites three possible fathers to her wedding, and everyone bursts into song at the altar.
A summer romance reignites in senior year when the girl next door meets the leather-jacket rebel she kissed, and the whole school sings.
A doctor's daughter spends the summer learning to dance with the resort's bad-boy instructor, and nobody puts their love story in a corner.
A city teen moves to a town where dancing is banned and rallies his classmates to overturn the law with song and defiance.
A welder who dances in a bar by night dares to audition for a prestigious academy, and her dream becomes a song of steel and light.
A Brooklyn clerk rules the disco floor by night until a woman's disappearance drags him into the neon underbelly of the city.
A farm boy braves a frontier of dangers, giants, and duels to rescue his true love from a wicked prince's scheme.
Three scientists start a paranormal cleanup business and save the city with wits, wallets, and proton packs when the dead come knocking.
Five teens from rival cliques are sentenced to a Saturday in detention, where they are tried, judged, and finally understood by each other.
A man is caught in a loop he cannot break, and with each dawn the small town's secrets and his own sins surface again.
A gang of kids plans a treasure heist through booby-trapped caverns while a family of criminals races them to the fortune.
A deep-space crew answers a distress signal and finds a nightmare waiting in the dark, hunting them one by one through the ship.
A child's bedroom grows cold and her voice turns strange, so her desperate mother summons two priests to a house that is no longer theirs.
A child psychologist discovers his young patient can see the dead, and the boy's house is full of visitors no one else can see.
A masked knife-wielder toys with a town of teens who know every horror movie rule by heart, and the game is personal.
An escaped killer in a white mask returns to his hometown and picks off babysitters one by one while the local doctor hunts him.
A documentary crew follows an ordinary man who does not know that his entire life, his town, and his marriage are the show.
A stranded pilot and the volleyball he talks to bicker their way through years of isolation until rescue or madness comes first.
A bullied teen is trained by a mysterious old master in a secret art that turns him into the neighborhood's unlikely champion.
A family of retired heroes stands trial for using their powers in public, and their case becomes the fight that brings capes back.
A sea princess trades her voice for legs and discovers the prince's court hides a darker bargain than the sea witch ever let on.
A street thief steals a magic lamp and plans the heist of a lifetime inside the sultan's palace, with a genie as his getaway.
A young woman is trapped in a cursed castle where every mirror, clock, and candlestick watches her, and the master hides in the shadows.
A singing governess arrives at a captain's mansion and discovers the children's mother never truly left the halls.
A documentary crew follows a mysterious nanny who claims she can fly, and the children she tends insist the camera saw it too.
A neighborhood kid climbs the mob ladder through the fifties and sixties until paranoia, greed, and one long night tear it all down.
A small-time exile builds a cocaine empire in a glittering city and drowns in the paranoia of his own excess.
After a jewelry heist goes horribly wrong, wounded strangers gather in a warehouse to discover which of them is the rat.
Two detectives hunt a methodical killer who stages his murders as lessons from the old book of deadly sins, and the finale is personal.
A mole inside the police and a cop inside the mob race to unmask each other before the walls close in on both of them.
A factory owner is called before a tribunal to account for the lives he saved and the ones he could not, in the shadow of atrocity.
A captain testifies about the mission to bring one soldier home, and the trial asks whether any single life is worth so many.
A street kid is arrested for cheating on a game show, and each answer he gives unlocks a brutal chapter of his past.
